Proposition
[Quotients of proper actions] 1. Proposition 8.2.2\group group actionsSource: thurston:page-0189 For a properly discontinuous action on a locally compact Hausdorff space, $X/\Gamma $ is Hausdorff; if the action is free, $X\to X/\Gamma $ is a covering projection.
Proof

\sketch Separate distinct orbits using compact neighborhoods and finitely many intersecting translates. Freeness permits a neighborhood disjoint from all its translates, which projects evenly.

□
